repos.name: Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP)
repos.role: Open standard from OpenAI and Stripe that lets an AI agent check out a cart at a merchant on behalf of a buyer.

repos.name: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)
repos.role: Open protocol, led by Google with retailers and platforms, that lets an AI agent find products, build a cart and pay at any merchant that supports it.

repos.name: Medusa
repos.role: Open-source commerce engine whose store and admin APIs let agents browse products, build carts and place orders.

repos.name: Saleor
repos.role: Headless commerce platform with a GraphQL API (and an official MCP server) that agents can use to search products, manage carts and place orders.

repos.name: WooCommerce
repos.role: WordPress store plugin that ships a built-in MCP endpoint, so an agent can read products and orders and act on a shop.

repos.name: Spree Commerce
repos.role: Open-source commerce platform with a local MCP server that lets an agent manage a store through chat.

repos.name: Vendure
repos.role: Headless commerce platform whose typed GraphQL shop API is built to be called by LLM tools, MCP servers and agent frameworks.

repos.name: Bagisto
repos.role: Open-source store and multi-vendor marketplace platform from India, with official agent skills and an MCP server for AI tools.

repos.name: Beckn-ONIX
repos.role: Adapter that connects buyer and seller apps to Beckn open networks such as India's ONDC, so any app or agent can discover and order from any seller on the network.

repos.name: ONDC Protocol Specs
repos.role: API specification of India's Open Network for Digital Commerce, which lets any buyer app search and order from sellers on any other app.

repos.name: Shop CLI and skill
repos.role: Official Shopify tool from Canada that lets an agent search Shopify stores, build a cart, check out and pay with the shopper's Shop account, then track the order.

repos.name: Shopify UCP CLI
repos.role: Shopify's shopping skill for agents that searches a global product catalog and builds carts and checkouts at any merchant that supports the Universal Commerce Protocol.

repos.name: Shopify AI Toolkit
repos.role: Official Shopify plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents that gives them Shopify's docs and API schemas and lets them manage a merchant's store.
